profile.headline: Software Engineer @Mindbody | CISSP, CSM, CAPM, ITIL | Building scalable solutions and business value.
profile.summary: Experienced engineer and manager that loves solving complex problems with solid solutions.

positions.locationName: San Luis Obispo, California, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer III - Developer Productivity
positions.description:
• Devised solutions to enhance developer productivity through metric-driven strategies, advanced AI tools, and streamlined workflows.
• Spearheaded project lifecycles from DACI framework setup, through requirements gathering, planning, approvals, implementation, testing, deployment, to ongoing maintenance.
• Implemented metrics collection for gauging developer productivity, pipeline efficiency, release management, and software environment health.
• Administered an array of systems, including pipeline tools, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), package management solutions, and security tools.
• Organized and maintained Service Catalog tools, facilitating improved service health monitoring and efficient asset discovery.
• Led cloud migration initiatives for internal tools and services.
• Designed the architecture and executed enhancements to an integrated software platform, covering aspects such as service/project creation, onboarding processes, environment management, networking, infrastructure oversight, and alert/monitoring setups.

positions.title: Software Engineer II - Core Reliability
positions.description:
• Implementation and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines for projects using cloud based solutions. 
• Facilitating company standards through metrics, policies, and automation. 
• Developing API, Web, and Serverless software. 
• Implementation of observability tools for SLO/SLI's. 
• Management of permissions for environments using least privilege principle. 
• Implementation of monitoring tools to view health and metrics of environments. 
• Maintenance of vulnerability and SCA scanning in pipelines. 
• Maintenance of software feature flags. 
• Technical documentation and system design. 
• Infrastructure as Code (IaC) management. 
• Ensure code reviews in release process. 
• Advisor to development teams to ensure minimal technical debt is being created

positions.title: DevOps Manager / Technical Project Manager II
positions.description:
• Implementation a continuous integration frameworks to automatically checkout, build, test, scan, package, and securely deploy release candidate products including: .NET applications, RESTful Web API's, IIS hosted web apps, ColdFusion applications, and Delphi applications
- Tools used: 
Jenkins (Declarative Pipeline, Master/Agent), PowerShell, Chocolatey, GitLab, Octopus Deploy, Vagrant, AWS Services and Tools (CloudWatch, API Gateway, VPC, EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, CodeDeploy, CodeCommit, IAM), VirtualBox, Katalon, Git, SVN, MSBuild, MSTest, HP Fortify SCA and WebInspect, Wireshark, WinSCP, AstroGrep, The Sleuth Kit.
• Manage and oversee the software release and deployment processes from development to production environments.
• Maintain development environments for including but not limited to: WCF applications, RESTful Web API's, IIS hosted web apps, ColdFusion applications, Delphi applications, networking configuration, database integrity and mirroring, security and overall server administration.
• Coordinate between various departments such as executive management, IT/IS, Networking, and Security to smoothly transition the release process.
• Ensure stability and security of all environments using monitoring tools such as Splunk along with forensic scanning for sensitive data.
• Training and mentoring during onboarding.

positions.title: QA Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and led the implementation of a .NET automation framework which automatically tests UI behavior of Shift4's proprietary Web applications using human-readable BDD driven tests.
  - Tools used: SpecFlow, Selenium Webdriver, C# binding, MSTest, XPath, Firebug/Firepath, MSBuild, JUnit, PowerShell, SVN, PicklesDoc Reporting, Cucumber, Gherkin, T-SQL, Visual Studio IDE, VMWare, Continuous Integration
• Testing to ensure correct API behavior and functionality for RESTful Web services. 
- Tools used: Fiddler Web Debugger, Apache log4net, Sublime Text, SoapUI, VMWare
• Maintenance of Role-based access control (RBAC) permissions
• Process lead on POS software certification
• Manage and implement proper Agile project management methodologies and best practices.
- Tools used: CA Agile Central (Formerly Rally)
• Investigating defects and assisting during the debugging process
• Implementation of automated regression testing
• Smoke testing during software release deployments
• Training and mentoring during onboarding

positions.title: OJT
positions.locationName: 123 Paseo de Roxas Street, Makati City 1229
positions.description:
• Created, updated, and managed essential contact databases
• Researched, marketed, and assisted with operations of forums, summits, conferences, and programs
• Analyzed and revised research reports and studies focused on developing regions in Asia
• Marketed ancillary and graduate programs offered within the institute
• Coordinated with various government agencies, NGO’s, multilaterals, and embassies/consulates
• Produced ad-hoc reports, presentations, data analysis summaries, and essential documents to upper management
• Administrative tasks included data entry, faxing, emailing, scanning, and answering/returning inquiries

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Medical relief mission conducted in the rural provincial area of Bogo, Philippines
• Conducted blood glucose testing and counseling to hundreds of patients in a 4 day span
• Effectively implemented a faster and cleaner system at the blood testing station in order to produce maximum efficiency with minimum risk for infection
